visuals.advice: A UI change shows through the visual baselines it changes, which this check puts in a before/after table comment, light beside dark: change them with the UI (e2e/screenshots/screens.yaml holds the screens), and once this PR's CI run has taken its screenshots, run Update visual baselines (visual-baselines.yml) on this branch, then approve the checks its push starts. For motion (a card swipe, an animation, a sheet or modal opening and closing, scrolling, a multi-step flow), add or edit the scenario in e2e/gifs/ (a Maestro flow, <name>.yaml; swipe-and-undo.yaml says how one is built) and push: once this PR's CI run finishes, PR GIFs attach (pr-gif-attach.yml) takes the videos its Screenshots and GIFs job recorded and main's, makes the GIFs and attaches them here, labelled GIF: (run PR GIFs, pr-gif.yml, by hand for a scenario this PR doesn't change, or a fork's PR). Only what no test can draw (the app icon, the launch screen, an iOS prompt) is dragged in by hand, with alt text `No test draws: <why>`. Or tick "No visible UI change" in the template. Editing the description re-runs this check.

readme-screenshots.source: the iOS Simulator shots CI's Screenshots and GIFs job took (mock library)

ciFixChecks: `npm run check` (what CI's unit job runs: lint, format check, typecheck, type coverage, depcruise, the native bridge check, tests with coverage; `npm run format` rewrites what the format check flags)
cannotRun: visual regression (its screenshots come from the iOS Simulator)

exempt.PR visuals: Wants new baselines from the Simulator or GIFs, which autofix can't make (autofix skips its failure too).
exempt.README screenshots: Runs as a PR closes, when there's nothing left for autofix to do.
